list.name: tenant
list.label: Tenant
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT toString(tenant_id) FROM telemetry_guard.tg_events ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSql: SELECT replaceOne(toString(ip), '::ffff:', '') AS ip, count() AS blocked_clicks, uniqExact(session_id) AS sessions FROM telemetry_guard.tg_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND kind = 'verdict' AND band = 'block' AND toString(tenant_id) IN (${tenant:singlequote}) GROUP BY ip ORDER BY blocked_clicks DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT assumeNotNull(asn) AS asn, any(coalesce(asn_org, '')) AS organisation, count() AS blocked_clicks, uniqExact(ip) AS distinct_ips FROM telemetry_guard.tg_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND kind = 'verdict' AND band = 'block' AND isNotNull(asn) AND toString(tenant_id) IN (${tenant:singlequote}) GROUP BY asn ORDER BY blocked_clicks DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT campaign_id, countIf(band = 'block') AS blocked_clicks, count() AS scored_clicks, round(100 * blocked_clicks / scored_clicks, 1) AS block_pct FROM telemetry_guard.tg_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND kind = 'verdict' AND campaign_id != '' AND toString(tenant_id) IN (${tenant:singlequote}) GROUP BY campaign_id ORDER BY blocked_clicks DESC LIMIT 20
